summary: Firefox can reject a pending AudioContext resume while close is in flight and the state getter still reports suspended. Record graph-owned retirement intent before issuing close; only already-issued unlock, suspend and resume operations may consume retired-context InvalidStateError cancellation. The close promise itself must report failures, including InvalidStateError. Active InvalidStateError and unexpected close errors remain observable. Retire host callbacks and decoded buffers on disposal. Browser controls hold the state-observation clock independently of the real context, deliver a captured voice completion after disposal, and assert failures inside the browser to avoid pageerror transport lag. Five disposal controls and three unexpected-failure controls retain the normal journey pageerror guard. This supersedes the earlier state-getter-based cancellation rule that failed real Firefox qualification.
title: Observe context-operation promises through Web Audio disposal
